entries.title: A running task stops using a model you took off every level
entries.body: When you take a model off every level in Settings, a task that was running on it now picks another model the next time its conversation opens, such as after you quit and reopen the app or when its conversation grows too long for the model and starts over. Its timeline says once which model it moved to. A task you started on a model by name keeps that model.
entries.noPicture: No view changes; the task's existing timeline shows one more line naming the model it moved to.
